claim: Google says net income up 298% YoY for the June 2026 quarter.
summary: The claim concerns Alphabet/Google Q2 2026 (June 2026 quarter) results, which post-date the 2026-01-04 knowledge cutoff. No knowledge establishes that such a report exists or that net income grew 298% YoY.

sub_claims.text: Google reported results for the June 2026 quarter
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before the end of the June 2026 quarter and its earnings release; existence of this report cannot be established from prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Google said net income was up 298% year-over-year
sub_claims.note: Q2 2026 net income YoY growth is after knowledge cutoff; 298% figure cannot be established from prior knowledge.
